parts:
Why I built FlowAI — and why existing productivity tools are broken.

A thread 🧵

1/ I've tried every productivity app. Notion, Todoist, Linear, Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Trello. All of them.

They all have the same problem: they make YOU do the organizing.

2/ Think about it. You spend 30 min planning your day. Then something changes. A meeting moves. A priority shifts.

Now your whole plan is stale. And you have to redo it.
3/ AI should handle this. Not "AI" that generates a to-do list once. Actually intelligent automation that adapts in real-time.

4/ That's FlowAI.

• It watches your calendar, tasks, and goals
• It builds your day automatically
• When things change, it restructures
• It learns your patterns over weeks

5/ After 3 months of beta testing:

Users save an average of 5.2 hours per week. Not by working faster — by eliminating the overhead of self-management.

6/ Early access is open now.

If you're tired of being your own project manager, try it.

→ flowai.app

Repost the first tweet if this resonated. Follow for more updates.

7 workflows FlowAI automates that used to eat my entire morning.

Save this thread — you'll want to try these 🧵

1/ Morning planning

Before: 25 min reviewing tasks, calendar, emails.
After: FlowAI sends me a priority-ranked schedule at 7am. I just start.

2/ Meeting follow-ups

Before: Write notes, create tasks, send recaps manually.
After: FlowAI joins the meeting, extracts action items, assigns them.

3/ Weekly reviews

Before: Manually compile what I did across 4 apps.
After: Auto-generated report with completions, blockers, and next week's plan.

4/ Email triage

Before: Read everything, decide what needs action.
After: FlowAI categorizes, drafts responses, creates tasks from requests.

5/ Project tracking

Before: Update status in Linear, Notion, and Slack.
After: One update propagates everywhere. Single source of truth.

6/ Focus time protection

Before: Hope nobody schedules over my deep work blocks.
After: FlowAI guards my calendar and suggests optimal focus windows.

7/ Goal tracking

Before: Set goals Jan 1, forget by Jan 15.
After: FlowAI breaks goals into weekly milestones and tracks them daily.

Try it → flowai.app
